sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution is that, mother of the victim lodged a report in the concerned police station on 21.12.2023 stating that her daughter is found missing from her house.

Based upon which,
initially, crime was registered for the ofence punishable under Section 363 of IPC.

During course of investigation, victim was recovered in possession of the applicant from Rice Mill at Gariyaband, her statement was recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. and thereafter, other ofences were also added and applicant was arrested 25.12.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the instant crime, he has not committed any ofence as alleged.
He submits that the victim by her own will has accompanied the applicant and the age of the victim on the date of incident was more than 18 years, hence, no ofence as alleged would be attracted.
Therefore, he may be enlarged on regular bail.

4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and would submit that on the date of incident, age of the victim was 17 years and 02 months.
He also submits that to prove the age of the victim, police collected her School Admission Register.
Hence, he may not be entitled bail.

5. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, victim along with her father appeared before this Court through virtual mode from D.L.S.A. Kondagaon and they submitted that they are having no objection in grant of bail to the applicant.
6.
I have heard learned counsel for the respective parties.

7. Taking into consideration, facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegations, submission of learned counsel for the respective parties as also, submission of the victim and the date of arrest of the applicant, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I am inclined to allow this application for grant of bail.
8.

Accordingly, the bail application iled under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to satisfaction of Trial Court concerned on the conditions that:
(i) He shall appear before the Trial Court concerned regularly on each and every date unless exempted from appearance.
(ii)He shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) If applicant is found involved in similar ofence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of bail.
Certiied as per rules.
